title: Q-Interference: Memory-Efficient Phase-Aware Quantum-Inspired Attention
abstract: arXiv:2608.17288v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GPT attention measures token compatibility through dot-product similarity. This mechanism is simple, effective, and memory-efficient. But it does not explicitly model whether strong token features should reinforce or suppress one another. We introduce Q-Interference, a fully classical quantum-inspired attention mechanism for autoregressive language modeling that augments each query and key feature with an amplitude and a learned phase. The resulting attention score is phase-aware which aligned phases contribute constructively while conflicting phases contribute destructively. Although Q-Interference yields a richer interaction rule than similarity alone, a naive implementation of Q-Interference requires a large token-pair-feature interaction tensor, making it memory-intensive and often impractical. translated_title: Q-干涉：内存高效、相位感知的量子启发式注意力机制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17288v1 公告类型：新 摘要：GPT注意力机制通过点积相似度来衡量令牌兼容性。这种机制简单、有效且内存高效，但它并未明确建模强令牌特征之间是应相互增强还是抑制。我们引入了Q-干涉，一种完全经典的量子启发式注意力机制，用于自回归语言建模，它为每个查询和键特征增加了振幅和学习的相位。由此产生的注意力分数是相位感知的，其中对齐的相位产生建设性贡献，而冲突的相位产生破坏性贡献。尽管Q-干涉提供了比单纯相似性更丰富的交互规则，但其朴素实现需要大型令牌-对-特征交互张量，使其内存密集且通常不切实际。为解决这一限制，我们提出了一种精确的三角分解方法，通过两次标准矩阵乘法计算相同的分数。
tldr: 本文提出Q-干涉，一种量子启发的相位感知注意力机制，通过三角分解实现内存高效，使令牌特征间的增强或抑制关系得以显式建模。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Q-Interference, a quantum-inspired phase-aware attention mechanism that achieves memory efficiency via trigonometric factorization, enabling explicit modeling of reinforcement or suppression between token features.
